description: Routes one input to two, three or four outputs in turn, moving on with each trigger

params.text: Picks whether two, three or four outputs are used; a red light marks the ones left out

inputs.text: A trigger moves to the next output, and a yellow light marks the one in use
A trigger goes back to the first output

outputs.text: Carries the input while that step is the active one, and 0V the rest of the time

notes: a patch saved before version 2.5.0 opens with De-click turned on, because that was how the module always worked; a newly added one has it off
menu: De-click — crossfades between steps over about 2.5ms, which stops the click that switching audio otherwise makes

inputs.0: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
